events.text: Atlas chooses SQLite as the authoritative evidence store because deployment needs no database service.
We rejected Kafka for the prototype because operating a broker adds deployment complexity.
Audio capture must use a bounded queue of four chunks and remain independent of the API worker.
Zimo owns microphone capture and local ASR integration.
Xiaolong owns versioned memory and immutable question snapshots.
Jiaxuan owns MCP tools and task skills. All exposed tools are read only.
Cai owns security policy and access revocation checks.
Qiyan owns evaluation and frozen replay questions.
The agreed timeout is thirty seconds.
Correction: the agreed timeout is twenty seconds.
The latency target is p95 below two seconds for local retrieval, excluding API generation.
OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages need distinct wire protocol tests.
Recordings require participant consent before opening the microphone.
Previous meetings require explicit opt in and current authorization.
API credentials belong in environment variables and never in traces or git.
Private assistant answers must never become shared meeting facts without explicit user promotion.
Late report: the launch budget is five hundred dollars.
Embeddings are deferred until retrieval evaluation justifies their footprint.
The final milestone is a cited CLI demonstration on December eleven.
Final transcript rewrite: the transport timeout remains twenty seconds; retries are disabled.

# Atlas implementation

File refresh is explicit; snapshots read retained content.
The connector excludes credentials and binary files.
